assetRole: Single front A-pose image-to-3D concept reference, not final 3D or animation asset
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: image-to-3D production character reference for the original game Viral Invasion.
Use the supplied character image as an IDENTITY, PALETTE and WORLD reference, not as the pose or camera to copy. Redesign this same friendly medical patrol robot into a polished, distinctive, fully designed hero suitable for skeletal 3D animation. This is a single front-view modeling reference, not a sheet.

Create ONE complete character in near-orthographic STRAIGHT FRONT view, full body, standard neutral A-pose: arms spread downward 35–45 degrees, open palms facing forward, all five gloved fingers visibly separated with simple geometry; feet apart, both legs and all limb joints unobscured. The silhouette must be clean with clear gaps between arms and torso and between legs. Face and body look directly forward. Entire helmet and both soles visible with generous margin. Approx. 3.25 heads tall: heroic compact proportions, purposeful visible thighs, knees and shins, not a tiny toy body or spindly legs.

DESIGN: an egg / subtle teardrop shaped warm ivory medical helmet; dark deep blue-green inset visor with two large clear mint luminous eyes, friendly but resolute; small mint medical cross integrated above visor. Softly beveled ceramic armor panels with an elegant, rounded silhouette, intentional panel seams and a little restrained painted wear. A shaped mint heart-shield chest panel and a small central purification energy chamber, integrated rather than a flat rectangular chest box. Warm ivory body and segmented limb armor, slate blue flexible joints, mint shoulder caps, mint forearm guards and mint kneepads. Sturdy medical combat boots and practical rounded gloves. Close fitting little medical backpack behind upper torso, its side edges and tops of two compact antibody capsules visible; two small close fitting first-aid belt pouches. No long cloth or loose tubing. Character looks agile, capable, kind, and memorable at small size in a 3/4 overhead combat game. Preserve the reference's medical sci-fi identity while upgrading the quality and silhouette substantially. No human face, no weapons, no base or podium.

STYLE: high quality stylized game character concept render, matte painted surfaces with subtle hand-painted color variation and broad readable shapes, warm storybook bio-tech fantasy, restrained soft illumination. Avoid glossy plastic toy, photoreal metal, generic rectangular robot torso, busy greebles and excessive neon. Palette: warm ivory 65%, muted mint 20%, deep slate / blue-green 15%, very restrained emissive mint eyes / energy details.
BACKGROUND AND CAMERA: plain light gray-white background, neutral even studio lighting, no dramatic cast shadows, no background elements. No text, labels, logo, watermark, callouts, panels, multiple views, or additional characters. Deliver one coherent, fully designed hero that is easy to reconstruct into a 3D mesh.

additionalDesign: heart-shield chest armor with purification chamber
compact backpack with paired antibody capsules
